title: ViewData / ViewBag / TempData / validation flow
meaning: ViewData is a dictionary for current-request view data.
ViewBag is dynamic syntax over ViewData.
TempData persists short-lived data across redirects, commonly for PRG success/error messages.
Validation state flows from model binding and validation into ModelState and is rendered by validation helpers/tag helpers.
For strongly typed page data, prefer view models over ViewData/ViewBag; use ViewData/ViewBag mainly for small UI metadata.
boundary_notes: R01 provides the base MVC view/controller context.
R03 contains validation tag helper infrastructure and should be checked in P02.
